reason: While dedicated folder isolation is an improvement, connecting an external tool to our firm's Google Drive is still too much of a confidentiality risk for sensitive ITR and ROC files without an independent audit. In an ordinary week, I would only ever test the free sandbox on a few sample files rather than committing to a paid plan.
objection: Granting third-party API access to our firm's Google Drive creates an unacceptable risk of client data exposure or accidental corruption during peer reviews.
would_change_my_mind: An independent third-party security certification confirming zero external access to file contents and strict folder isolation.
